description: This file defines the ClaimAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_claim_attachment'. It includes properties like request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, attachment content, file type, associated user, and attachment date, along with getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: ClaimAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing an attachment associated with a claim request in OrangeHRM. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties such as request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, attachment content, file type, user who attached it, and attachment date, with corresponding getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Gets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Gets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment content or resource.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Gets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who attached the file.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Gets the date when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the attachment was added.
